title: DEMA User Gateway Identity and Routing Foundation Contract
scope: Pure policy contract for a future tenant-scoped business gateway; no transport, persistence, public route, or runtime activation is included.

mapping_rules: An invalid, unknown, or unmapped Telegram identity is denied.
Each Telegram identity maps to exactly one explicit user and tenant context.
Duplicate Telegram mappings and ambiguous user-to-tenant mappings are rejected.
The platform_admin role belongs to a separate owner/admin boundary and is never granted by Telegram mapping or default registration.

user.scope: Own user and tenant business requests only.

tenant_admin.scope: Tenant business administration and tenant-scoped business requests only.

platform_admin.scope: Separate owner/admin boundary; not a Telegram User Gateway role.

tenant_context_rules: Tenant context is taken only from resolved identity context.
Request input may be checked against the resolved tenant but cannot select or replace it.
A user role cannot act for another internal user; tenant_admin remains within its tenant.
foundation_behavior: Only catalog lookup, request routing, tenant-scoped business request, and proposal behavior are modeled.
All unknown capabilities are denied by default.
DEMA Assistant and DEMA Lead are routing boundaries only in this foundation contract.
security_invariants: This contract does not alter the existing owner control plane or separate runtime API.
No real user identities, credentials, tokens, secrets, or absolute paths are part of this artifact.
The existing phase1 readiness proposal and roster remain outside this contract and are not mutated.
